data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002 claims a contradiction relation (logical decentralization is negated when physical dependencies intersect), but it supplies no causal mechanism connecting 'dependency intersection' to the collapse of logical decentralization. The target does not define what threshold of intersection triggers systemic collapse, nor why intersecting physical dependencies necessarily negate logical decentralization rather than merely degrading it. The 'refuted if' clause itself betrays this gap: it defers the entire causal content to an unspecified 'threshold required to trigger a systemic collapse,' making the contradiction conditional on a mechanism that is never articulated. A contradiction relation demands a causal account of how physical intersection propagates to logical negation; absent that, the claim is a bare correlation.
